correctness.rationale: The published multiplicity formula has block size m_c-2j+1 with m_c=d-dim(c) and j>=0. Size d+1 therefore forces the unique zero cone and j=0. The source's zero-cone local polynomial is 1, so its only local age is 0 with multiplicity one, while degree-zero primitive intersection cohomology has multiplicity one. Hence J_{d+1,1}=1 and all J_{d+1,lambda} for lambda!=1 vanish; larger blocks are impossible.

value.rationale: The top nilpotent Jordan layer is a canonical structural invariant of degeneration monodromy. Exact uniqueness upgrades a mere upper bound to a rigid statement and shows maximal nilpotency persists uniformly across the new nonsimplicial weak-Fano Laurent class, providing a compact boundary condition for mirror and limiting-Hodge calculations even when lower blocks remain combinatorially complicated.
